P03.current_evidence: Guided tools retain selected context; explicit GFS/best-match comparison and both national historical measures now survive the rules path. Multi-turn and unfamiliar compound-request generalisation remain open. Stakeholder repairs preserve historical measure order and prevent notification verbs becoming places. Tezpur observed-water-level browser request is explicitly unavailable, with no weather substitution.

P04.current_evidence: Official sea-area and coastal text is reachable as published documents with page, issue and currency attached, while the marine tool returns modeled wave cells at the answering grid. Named sea-area identity, printed validity windows and a domain-reviewed specialist composition remain open; the recorded decision is not to invent a mapping.

P06.current_evidence: Activity-plan monitoring and separate legacy-watch outbox, opt-in Web Push and acknowledgements are implemented. The plans and inbox panel can now revoke the browser subscription it holds, and it shows the local delivery counts per place and per official source with the statement that a count is not a receipt. Synthetic real-HTTP inbox lifecycle passes. Actual changed-edition device delivery, origin, flood/cyclone applicability, unified scheduling and rural/mobile delivery remain unaccepted; see docs/73.

P07.current_evidence: District and national corpus queries, cross-language retrieval and bounded whole-edition section coverage are connected. The new live national reading served 11 indexed sections. Held layouts, contradiction handling and field applicability remain open. The indexed corpus now has a front door of its own: /api/corpus lists every indexed document with its printed issue date, measured currency, page and passage counts and the state of its saved body, and the Published-documents surface renders it with a family selector and provenance disclosures. The measured index on this machine holds 588 documents, 7,372 passages, 12 families, 570 regions, 584 held bodies and 4 pruned ones; listing the corpus is not nationwide acceptance and establishes no applicability.

P08.current_evidence: Historical district misses now offer source-lined place-index candidates (alternate spellings such as Mysore, and the district a settlement falls in such as Khurda) that require confirmation; two live journeys answered after selection and an unknown name kept the refusal. No reviewed dated crosswalk exists, so no automatic alias resolution is claimed.

P09.current_evidence: Stored forecast vintages were compared for 4,032 overlapping valid hours: mean absolute change 0.70 C for temperature, 3.98 percent for humidity, 0.94 mm for precipitation, with the largest change coming from two retrievals one second apart. This is vintage variance, not skill: upstream run identity is not exposed and no matched observations exist, so no accuracy, calibration or confidence number is produced.

P10.current_evidence: Request-driven collection, a bounded foreground cycle, scheduled briefing loop and local background plan watcher exist. Shared-store contention, cold latency, sustained refresh and multi-user throughput remain unaccepted.

P11.current_evidence: Bounded queue, stage progress and cooperative cancellation are implemented. Source read/lock latency and an in-flight provider call can still outlast page waits; no load acceptance.

P12.current_evidence: Benchmark scorer v2 allocates each declared measure once, checks execution parameters and preserves failed-turn denominators. Both initial failures and the release run are retained. It is still status-based development evidence, not independent correctness or representative generalisation.

P13.current_evidence: The desktop workspace exposes fifteen guided tools and every declared read-model path has a direct surface. The Today surface opens with a Now band that places the observed instant, the published district window and the model hours on one axis, and the shell keeps a local shortlist of pinned places reachable from the command palette and the topbar. The frontend overhaul is under way: a token layer (tokens.css), a chart engine v2 (viz.js) and its first two signature visuals — the ensemble member plume and the multi-parameter meteogram — are wired into the Ensemble and Forecast surfaces, with motion primitives and a focus ring. The language ledger has 19 verified write gates and 10 speak/hear gates; voice controls and audio probes exist. Native-speaker, noisy-input, screen-reader and real mobile acceptance remain open. Loading states now reserve the shape of the answer without carrying a number, the evidence receipt can be copied or printed, and a local compare tray reads up to three places side by side without differencing them. The Map reads out a districts published day on hover and focus, loads the vendored city layer so a settlement can be selected as the working place at its own coordinates, and states in its legend what is drawn and how many of each. Surface changes are offered as a view transition where the browser supports one, and a print block keeps the published colours and drops hover-only controls so a printed page carries the same distinctions as the screen. The Today surface lays out the five published days as columns with the source colours, counts the model hours into the IST day their timestamp falls in, places the station on the day it reported, and states that it computes no daily value. The overhaul was verified in a real browser: eight surfaces, twelve screenshots at four viewport/appearance combinations, and four defects repaired that no component suite could see (missing surface hosts, a hyphenated route, an invalid element tag, and SVG text created outside the SVG namespace).

P14.current_evidence: The working tree passes 1,139 Python tests, ten Node component suites, the frontend workspace audit and all 27 verification steps on this macOS Python 3.9 host, with the status drift guard green. The frontend overhaul batch adds a token layer and a chart engine pinned by tests/test_viz.js (gaps stay gaps, locators travel with every drawn point). Live loopback records are in research/reviews/frontend-overhaul-20260915, corpus-and-surfaces-20260915 and frontend-delivery-20260915; no DOM or browser rendering was available in the session sandbox. Fresh-machine/Windows installation, real-device notification delivery, CI, sustained load and deployment remain unaccepted; hosting held.

P15.current_evidence: Current review pointers and stage summaries now target docs/72; the previous product registry is archived. Historical snapshots are labelled as such, and the status drift guard remains in verification.
